translations.title: Was It Possible I Did Not Know You Were There?
translations.text:
Was it possible I did not know you were
near me, lost among the glances?

My eyes ached from waiting.
You passed by.

If only, appearing then,
you had revealed to me
the true country where you lived!

But you passed by
like a destroyed god.

Alone afterward, out of the darkness
came your gaze.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: The Night, Always Ambiguous...
translations.text:
The night, always ambiguous,
enrages you—your eyes,
the color of bad gin,
are like vipers.

I know you are about to burst
into insults and hysterical
tears. In bed, afterward,
I will calm you

with kisses I am sorry
to give you. And as you sleep
you will press against me
like a sick bitch.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: It Is Raining on the Sea...
translations.text:
It is raining on the sea.
At the open window,
watching it, you rest
your temple against the glass.

An image for a few seconds:
still against the light,
your changed body, still
naked from the night.

And you turn toward me,
smiling. I think
how time has passed,
and remember you this way.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: My Memory Was Images...
translations.text:
My memory was images
of you in that instant:
that expression, a shade
in your eyes, something soft

in the inflection of your voice,
and your furtive yawns
like a greyhound that slept poorly
through the night in my room.

To return, after years,
to happiness—
to see each other and remember
that I too have changed.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: I Do Not Want You to Descend Like Night...
translations.text:
I do not want you
to descend like night;
I want not fulfillment
but revelation.
Descend upon my eyes
swift as rain.
Like a furious lightning bolt,
burst in with a crack
while things remain
motionless in the light.
For I do not want a sweet,
lingering caress,
but that powerful
embrace in which I break.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: I Will Never Be Young Again
translations.text:
That life was serious
is something one begins to understand later.
Like all young people, I came
to take life by storm.

I wanted to leave my mark
and depart to applause.
Growing old, dying, were merely
the dimensions of the theater.

But time has passed
and the unpleasant truth appears:
growing old, dying,
is the play's only plot.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: Fear Comes On
translations.text:
Fear comes on in a motionless
wave. Suddenly, here,
it hints at itself:
the familiar structures, the possible

anticipated consequences (which do not rule out
the worst),
all the slow command of intelligence
and its alternative decisions, all

is clouded in an instant.
And only the root remains,
something like a painful antenna,
fallen one knows not where, still throbbing.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: Through the Mirror
translations.text:
Like dwarfs and monkeys along the border
of a tapestry in which you strode,
drunk, pursuing young women...
Or like the faithful, attending
—while you enchanted us—
the holy sacrifice of fame
for your excessive intelligence,
that was what we all were to you. Your life
was wasted labors of seduction.

And your good poems, lures
after the revelry to keep us there.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.

translations.title: The Outskirts (III)
translations.text:
City,
already so far away!

Far away beside the sea: harbor afternoons
and the wandering desolation of the docks.
The rising tides will stubbornly return
for those distant hours.

And they will become a murmur,
a pulse struggling as it falls asleep,
when the lights of night appear
above the sea.

Deeper, ever deeper,
you go with me, city,
like a sunken love
beyond repair.

Sometimes a wave and at other times silence.
translations.editorial_note: Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.
